design.menuDescription: Navigate Narra’s research introduction and early access.

signedOut.title: Your research starts here.
signedOut.body: Sign in securely, verify your Solana wallet, and check your access.

checking.title: Checking your access...
checking.body: We’re checking your verified wallets and current membership.

noWallet.title: Make it your wallet.
noWallet.body: Connect a Solana wallet and prove you control it with a message signature.

connecting.title: Choose your Solana wallet.
connecting.body: Connect through the wallet window, then select the address below. You can cancel and try again.

challenge.title: Read before you sign.
challenge.body: This message proves wallet control for research access only. It authorizes no transaction.

signing.title: Confirm the message in your wallet.
signing.body: Your wallet is waiting for you. Reject the request if anything looks unfamiliar.

verifying.title: Verifying your wallet proof.
verifying.body: We’re checking your signature against the original challenge.

linked.title: Wallet verified. You’re ready.
linked.body: Join early access, or check for a Wyntrax membership associated with your verified wallet.

joining.title: Reserving your access.
joining.body: We’re confirming availability. Please don’t submit another request.

active.title: You’re in.
active.body: Your research access is active. Your wallet remains under your control.

disabled.title: Early access is not open yet.
disabled.body: Check back later. Existing Wyntrax members can still sign in and verify their membership wallet.

full.title: Early access is currently full.
full.body: All available places have been taken. Existing members can still check their access.

inviteOnly.title: Access is invitation-only.
inviteOnly.body: New self-service joins are not available. Existing members can still sign in and check access.

waitingSync.title: Waiting for membership sync
waitingSync.body: Wyntrax sends membership updates by webhook. We’ll check for up to two minutes; updates can take a little longer.

syncExpired.title: No membership update yet.
syncExpired.body: Automatic checks have stopped. Confirm that you verified the wallet holding your membership token.

unlinking.title: Unlinking your wallet.
unlinking.body: Research access derived from this wallet will be recalculated.

leaving.title: Leaving early access.
leaving.body: We’re releasing your self-service early-access reservation.

error.title: We couldn’t finish that step.
error.body: Check the explanation below, then try again when you’re ready.

flow.sameWallet: Use the same Solana wallet that holds your Wyntrax membership token; a new Privy embedded wallet usually won’t hold it.
flow.reviewMessage: Verify this site’s origin and your address in the full message below.
flow.haveMembership: This wallet may hold my Wyntrax membership token
flow.noExpiry: No expiry is currently scheduled for your active sources.
flow.claimPrompt: Still nothing? Claim your membership on Wyntrax.
flow.claimUnavailable: The Wyntrax claim link has not been configured. Contact the operator for the official link.
flow.unlinkBody: Membership access from this address ends immediately. Your early-access reservation stays yours, but needs a verified wallet to be usable.
flow.leaveBody: Your self-service reservation will be revoked. Rejoining depends on availability. Separate Wyntrax membership and admin grants are unaffected.
flow.rateWait: Please wait for the rate-limit cooldown before trying again.
flow.existingMember: Already have a membership? Sign in to check it.
flow.seats: {count, plural, one {# place available} other {# places available}}
flow.seatsUnknown: Availability will be confirmed when you join.
flow.statusUnavailable: Availability is temporarily unavailable. You can still sign in to check existing access.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: The request could not be accepted. Refresh access and start the step again.
errors.WALLET_LINK_UNAVAILABLE: Wallet verification is temporarily unavailable. Retry later; the operator may need to configure the site origin.
errors.WALLET_LIMIT: You can link up to five wallets. Unlink one before adding another.
errors.CHALLENGE_LIMIT: Too many wallet challenges are open. Wait five minutes, then start again.
errors.CHALLENGE_UNAVAILABLE: This challenge expired or was already used. Refresh and request a new message.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That record is no longer available. Refresh your access.
errors.EARLY_ACCESS_DISABLED: Early access is closed for new joins. Check again later.
errors.EARLY_ACCESS_FULL: No early-access places are currently available. Check again later.
errors.VERIFIED_WALLET_REQUIRED: Verify a Solana wallet before joining.
errors.INVITES_UNAVAILABLE: Self-service invitations are not available. Contact the operator.
errors.ENTITLEMENTS_UNAVAILABLE: Access checks are temporarily unavailable. Retry in a moment.
errors.FEATURE_LOCKED: This feature needs a higher access tier. Review your membership.
errors.NETWORK: We couldn’t reach the API. Check your connection and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The step took too long. Retry to check the current state before attempting it again.
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The API returned an unexpected response. Retry; contact the operator if this continues.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Sign out and sign in again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait for the cooldown, then retry.
errors.INVALID_WALLET_PROOF: The wallet signature could not be verified. Request a new challenge and use the selected wallet.
errors.WALLET_UNAVAILABLE: This wallet is unavailable or already linked. Refresh access or choose another wallet.
errors.DOMAIN_MISMATCH: Signing blocked: the message’s Domain does not exactly match this site’s origin. Do not sign it. Ask the operator to correct the wallet-link domain.
errors.WALLET_REJECTED: The wallet did not complete signing. Refresh and try again when ready.
errors.CONFIGURATION: The public API URL is missing or invalid. Ask the operator to configure it.
errors.UNKNOWN: This step could not be completed. Refresh access and try again.

common.disclaimer: Research tool. Not financial advice. We never ask for your seed phrase or for a transaction.
common.privacy: Sign-in is handled by Privy. We store your verified wallet address and your access level.
common.errorBody: Please try again. Your wallet and access remain under your control.
common.notFound: This page is off the radar.
common.coming: Your research workspace is coming in Phase 2.

access.headline: See the narrative before the crowd does.
access.subcopy: AI-ranked narratives and smart-money signals on Solana. Join the early access to get in first.

auth.configure: Sign-in needs a public Privy app ID. The operator must configure NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID and allow this web origin in Privy.
auth.reload: Reload this page to try again. No wallet action has been taken.

landing.eyebrow: A clearer view of what’s forming
landing.howTitle: Follow the signal. Understand the story.
landing.howBody: Connect the conversation, the tokens and the wallets. Make up your own mind with more context.
landing.step1Body: See narratives by stage and momentum. Understand what is emerging and what is already crowded.
landing.step2Body: Explore related tokens and tracked-wallet activity, with the uncertainty kept in view.
landing.step3Body: Research is context, not a promise. Check the evidence and decide what deserves a closer look.
landing.previewBody: Explore an interactive sample of the research workspace. All figures below are illustrative, not live signals or performance claims.
landing.sampleNote: Sample score history. Not price, returns or a forecast.
landing.accessBody: Research features follow your verified access level. Wallet ownership and membership are checked separately.
landing.tierNote: Feature comparison uses the shared default tier policy. Your actual access also follows server settings, expiry and any eligibility-age requirement. Token requirements have not been published.
landing.trust1Body: Wallet proof confirms that you control an address. It authorizes no transaction and grants no permission to move funds.
landing.trust2Body: Privy handles sign-in. Connect your external Solana wallet or choose an embedded wallet, then verify the address you intend to use.
landing.trust3Body: Narra stores your verified wallet address and access level, along with membership validity and security audit records. We never ask for your seed phrase.
landing.faq1Title: Does joining let Narra use my funds?
landing.faq1Body: No. The wallet proof signs a human-readable message for research access only. It does not authorize a transaction, delegation or transfer.
landing.faq2Body: Verify the same Solana wallet that holds your Wyntrax membership token. A newly created embedded wallet usually does not hold that token.
landing.faq3Title: Why isn’t my membership showing yet?
landing.faq3Body: Wyntrax sends membership updates by webhook. Updates can take a few minutes. Verify the correct wallet and check that your membership has been claimed on Wyntrax.
landing.faq4Body: No. Narra is a research tool. Scores, rankings and wallet relationships are signals with limitations, not guarantees or predictions of returns.
landing.finalTitle: The next story starts before the headlines.
landing.finalBody: Build your own view of the narratives taking shape on Solana.
